title: Abandoned Popcorn Time app exposed millions of devices to RCE attacks
description: The abandoned Time4Popcorn app, a fork of the Popcorn Time BitTorrent client, contained a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in its updater mechanism. The updater contacted an abandoned domain over unencrypted HTTP and accepted unsigned executables, allowing anyone controlling the domain to execute code with SYSTEM/root privileges on millions of Windows and macOS devices. Researchers mitigated the risk by registering the domain and remotely disabling the updater through a remediation payload. However, Android users remain exposed, and the app's outdated embedded Chrome engine presents additional risks. Users are advised to uninstall the software entirely.
